from __future__ import annotations
import io, unittest
from pathlib import Path
suite=unittest.TestLoader().discover(str(Path("tests/model_execution")),pattern="test_direct_sol_chat.py")
res=unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=io.StringIO(),verbosity=2).run(suite)
print("TESTS="+str(res.testsRun)+" ERRORS="+str(len(res.errors))+" FAILS="+str(len(res.failures)))
for i,(test,tb) in enumerate(res.errors,1):
    lines=[x.strip() for x in tb.splitlines() if x.strip()]
    print("ERR"+str(i)+"="+str(test)+" :: "+" | ".join(lines[-14:]))
for i,(test,tb) in enumerate(res.failures,1):
    lines=[x.strip() for x in tb.splitlines() if x.strip()]
    print("FAIL"+str(i)+"="+str(test)+" :: "+" | ".join(lines[-14:]))
raise SystemExit(17)
